request: Arrange the supplied fictional workshop into five readable pages. Keep each supplied line exactly.
sourceText:
Paper workshop
This is a fictional local club exercise about folding a paper model.
---
Choose a shape
Use a simple design and keep the instructions beside the paper.
---
Fold and compare
Follow one crease at a time, then compare the model with the instructions.
---
Inspect the model
Check the folds and note where a step needs a clearer explanation.
---
Keep a record
Save the instructions and the observations for the next workshop.
